what: Test baseline on main (87ed5e8) before any Kandha change, Linux cloud container
platform: Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.3 venv from requirements-cloud.lock (torch 2.8.0+cpu), Node 22.22.0

pytest.note: The first run failed tests/test_device_failures.py because the container had no PortAudio library (OSError: PortAudio library not found) and could not import PySide6 without libEGL. After apt-get install libportaudio2 libegl1 (and the usual QtWebEngine X libraries) every test passed. Both are system libraries, not repository code.
